details.description: Kimi K2.7 Code is a coding-focused, agentic large language model from Moonshot AI, built on the Kimi K2.6 checkpoint within Moonshot's Kimi K2 series. It uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 1 trillion total parameters and 32 billion activated per token, a 256K-token context window, and a MoonViT vision encoder for image input, and its Hugging Face card lists it under a Modified MIT License. Fireworks AI, which hosts the model, states its serverless offering begins deprecating the model on September 25, 2026, recommending Kimi K3 or GLM-5.3 as replacements for serverless workloads.
advantages: Reduces thinking-token usage by about 30% compared to its Kimi K2.6 predecessor while improving real-world long-horizon coding performance, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 81.1 on MCPMark-Verified and 76.0 on MCP Atlas, indicating strong tool-use via MCPs (Model Context Protocol), per its Hugging Face model card.
Supports native INT4 quantization and is documented for deployment with vLLM, SGLang, and KTransformers, per its Hugging Face model card.
Integrates with the Kimi Code CLI as its recommended agent framework for coding workflows, per its Hugging Face model card.
disadvantages: Fireworks AI states its serverless offering begins deprecating this model on September 25, 2026, recommending Kimi K3 or GLM-5.3 as replacements; on-demand GPU deployments remain available.
Scores 62.0 on Kimi Code Bench v2, versus a 69.0 score it reports for GPT-5.5 on the same benchmark, per its Hugging Face model card.
use_cases: Complex, long-horizon coding tasks across large, existing codebases
Agentic coding workflows that call external tools via MCPs (Model Context Protocol)
Terminal and CLI-based coding through the Kimi Code CLI agent framework

notes: Catalog's max_input_tokens (262144) matches the 256K context stated on the model's Hugging Face card, and catalog's deprecation_date (2026-09-25) matches Fireworks' own stated serverless deprecation start date exactly. The catalog's modality list (image_input, text_input, text_output) omits video, though the Hugging Face card also describes video input support; kept the catalog's value per instructions. No separate GitHub repository for K2.7-Code was found (the general MoonshotAI/Kimi-K2 GitHub repo covers only Kimi-K2-Base and Kimi-K2-Instruct), so github_url is null.
